definitions.explanation: A specific field, domain, or community of people sharing a common profession, interest, or characteristic. Often used as a suffix.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{芸能|げいのう}{界|かい}→芸能界：15094_geinoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}している→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: She is active in the entertainment world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧{界|かい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a big change in the political world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学会|がっかい}→学会：04139_gakkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学術|がくじゅつ}→学術：12280_gakujutsu⟧{界|かい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{集|あつ}まり→集まり：01689_atsumari⟧だ。
examples.english: Academic conferences are important gatherings in the scholarly world.

notes:
{界|かい} is primarily used as a suffix meaning "world" or "realm" attached to a field, profession, or domain. It is rarely used as a standalone word.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{芸能|げいのう}{界|かい}→芸能界：15094_geinoukai⟧: entertainment industry
- ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧{界|かい}: political world
- ⟦{財|ざい}{界|かい}→財界：22340_zaikai⟧: financial/business world
- {学|がっ}{界|かい}: academic world
- ⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧{界|かい}: sports world
- ⟦{業|ぎょう}{界|かい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧: industry (specific business sector)

USAGE:
The pattern is [field]{界|かい} to refer to the community of people and institutions in that field. It can also mean "sphere" in a more abstract or scientific sense, as in ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧ (the world).

REGISTER:
Common in news reporting and formal writing when discussing professional fields.
